mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS falls below 1.0% and remains below for 2 months, it triggers aggressive monetary policy easing that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has been below 1.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In recessionary conditions (GDP contraction), a decline in residential sales (RSAFS) signals worsening consumer demand, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during recessionary periods when RSAFS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800,000 units for 2 consecutive months, it signals deepening housing market collapse, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where HOUST remains below 800.0 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) over 3 months indicate severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a decline in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) predicts negative equity returns due to reduced real growth prospects over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when CPIAUCSL declines.
